test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 8 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence.

__Don’t provoke Harsha__, otherwise, she will give you a slap.
solution:
The solution is **Do not exasperate Harsha.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The option that will improve the underlined part of " Don’t provoke Harsha__, otherwise, she will give you a slap. " is Do not exasperate Harsha.
 
• Do not exasperate Harsha, otherwise, she will give you a slap.
 
• Here the word ***provoke ***and ***exasperate ***defines **irritate and frustrate someone intensely.**
 
 
• ​*For example : " A teacher can provoke you into working hard."**​*
 
 
 
• *​*As both the options have similar meaning.
